note: Relay's service level objectives (ADR-037). Each SLI counts events a user would call good. Period: 30 days, rolling. Burn-rate policy 'workbook' is the multi-window, multi-burn-rate table of Google's Site Reliability Workbook ('Alerting on SLOs'); 'ai-quality' is Relay's own, for SLIs whose labels arrive slowly and in small numbers. Reviewed with the budget policy (budget-policy.md) every quarter.

slos.title: Relay API requests answered without a server error
slos.sli: share of /v1 responses with a status below 500 (401, 403, 404 and 429 count as good: the server did what it promised)

slos.title: Relay API requests answered within 250 ms
slos.sli: share of /v1 responses with status below 500 and a duration of at most 0.25 s (a bucket boundary of the duration histogram); stricter than CON-4's p95 under 1 second

slos.title: Triage jobs answered within 60 seconds
slos.sli: share of triage jobs that reach done or needs_human within 60 s of being queued
slos.source: relay.worker.passes and the queue's job times

slos.title: Triage suggestions a person accepts unchanged
slos.sli: share of confirmed or overridden suggestions whose category and priority the person kept (online evaluation; Chapter 7's held-out accuracy for triage-v3.1 was 86.0%)

slos.title: Triage outputs that pass the output check
slos.sli: share of model outputs that parse as a suggestion and pass the content rules (no URL, no instruction to a person, no field outside the schema)
